purpose: Prove group_key answers 'which QUESTION does this control belong to' - scoped to the owning form for native radios, to the declared container for ARIA card sets - and stays empty when no grouping was DECLARED. Plus (M2.1) that question_label carries the application's OWN wording for it, from a declared accessible-name rung only, and is EMPTY when the page declares none.
targeted_defect: None (regression guard). Pins groupKeyOf()/groupContainerKey() including the form-scoping rule (two forms may both use name='product' and they are NOT the same question) and the declared-signal-only rule for checkbox groups. Pins questionOf()/questionLabelOf() (M2.1): the catalogue used to name a bare-button question 'Question 3' and a radio group after one of its ANSWERS, because nothing read the container that states the question.

expect_controls.why: the radiogroup is four levels up - found only by walking, not by checking the parent
no name attribute and no declared grouping ancestor - ungrouped is the only honest answer

fields.question_label: Have you used tobacco in the last 12 months? Include cigarettes, vaping and nicotine replacement.

fields.question_label: How much cover do you need?

expect_controls.why: the honest answer when an application states no wording. The question is still IDENTIFIED (question_key), so the catalogue can carry it as UNVERIFIED rather than invent text for it
no declared container anywhere - nothing to read a question from
a <legend> that is present and says nothing is not wording. Different from having no legend at all, and reported the same honest way: UNVERIFIED, never a guess

group_key_partition.why: The set of DISTINCT group_keys is the set of questions the page asks. Asserting the partition catches a collapse (two questions merged) and a shatter (one question split) that a per-control assertion alone would miss. Subject G contributes NO key, so the partition also proves that an undeclared group is left undeclared rather than invented. M2.1 adds three more declared questions (an aria-labelledby radiogroup, a role=group headed by an <h2>, and a fieldset that states no wording at all), so the partition moves from 7 to 10.

question_label_partition.why: Every DECLARED question either has the application's wording or has none, and which of those it is has to be visible per rung. Counted as a partition so a rung that silently stops resolving cannot be masked by another rung still working.
